verdict.overall: Since Sunday, PLTR weakened the most (price down 4.6%, with its floor and ceiling both pulled lower) while APP and BE jumped hard, though APP's surge lands right before its 11-04 earnings and sits inside very pricey options. AVGO and TSLA's nearest week look like the cleanest range setups, with AVGO's floor rising under price and TSLA's near-term score turning neutral, but AMAT and NVDA's down-trends plus upcoming earnings and broadly pricey options on TSLA, NVDA, ZETA and APP keep confidence in the better setups only modest.

tickers.TSLA: Since Sunday: little changed - price is flat near $399, but the nearest week's setup improved from opposing to neutral, with the floor rising to 380 and ceiling lifting to 440. Later weeks still lean opposing around a 380 magnet, and near-term options are pricey.
tickers.PLTR: Since Sunday: weaker - price fell 4.6% and the nearest floor dropped from 180 to 150 while the ceiling slipped to 195, pulling the whole range lower. The setup stays neutral, but the down-trend and bearish momentum keep pressure on, with options pricey near-term.
tickers.NVDA: Since Sunday: little changed - price edged up 1.2% and the setup stays neutral, though the nearest ceiling eased to 220 and the magnet dipped to 207.5. Options are pricey across the board, and earnings land 11-17, inside the next four weeks, adding event risk.
tickers.ZETA: Since Sunday: little changed - price is roughly flat near $31 and the neutral setup holds, with floor steady at 30 and ceiling at 35. Options are very pricey given high volatility, and unusually busy trading today near the magnet level could make it less reliable short-term.
tickers.AMAT: Since Sunday: weaker - price fell 2.2% to 381.70 even as the nearest floor rose to 375 right under price; the magnet also fell, to 412.5. The down-trend and bearish momentum continue, and earnings on 11-12 fall inside the next four weeks, adding risk.
